judgingDefinitions.streak_candidate: Reuses current counted-streak results; challenge completion tracking still needs implementation and validation.
judgingDefinitions.timed_engine: Requires a bounded timer and event-window scoring; not implemented by the current target label.
judgingDefinitions.series_engine: Requires round state, restart rules and series scoring.
judgingDefinitions.technique_review: Left/right-foot or exact-technique judging is not qualified in the main app. Practice/self-check first; a friend result needs explicit video sharing and peer agreement.
judgingDefinitions.friend_engine: Requires invitations, shared rules, attempts, deadlines and match results. No existing friend match service is assumed.

challenges.title: First 3
challenges.objective: Reach 3 consecutive counted touches. A hand, catch or ground contact ends the streak.

challenges.title: Find Five
challenges.objective: Reach 5 consecutive counted touches. A hand, catch or ground contact ends the streak.

challenges.title: First 10
challenges.objective: Reach 10 consecutive counted touches. A hand, catch or ground contact ends the streak.

challenges.title: Twenty Club
challenges.objective: Reach 20 consecutive counted touches. A hand, catch or ground contact ends the streak.

challenges.title: Thirty Flow
challenges.objective: Reach 30 consecutive counted touches. A hand, catch or ground contact ends the streak.

challenges.title: Half Century
challenges.objective: Reach 50 consecutive counted touches. A hand, catch or ground contact ends the streak.

challenges.title: Century Club
challenges.objective: Reach 100 consecutive counted touches. A hand, catch or ground contact ends the streak.

challenges.title: Beat Your Best
challenges.objective: Reach one more than your recorded personal best. Freeze the target when you enter; use 3 if there is no prior streak.

challenges.title: Right Foot 3
challenges.objective: Complete 3 consecutive touches with only your right foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Left Foot 3
challenges.objective: Complete 3 consecutive touches with only your left foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Right Foot 10
challenges.objective: Complete 10 consecutive touches with only your right foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Left Foot 10
challenges.objective: Complete 10 consecutive touches with only your left foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Right Foot 25
challenges.objective: Complete 25 consecutive touches with only your right foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Left Foot 25
challenges.objective: Complete 25 consecutive touches with only your left foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Right Foot 50
challenges.objective: Complete 50 consecutive touches with only your right foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Left Foot 50
challenges.objective: Complete 50 consecutive touches with only your left foot. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Weaker Foot 10
challenges.objective: Complete 10 consecutive touches with only your weaker foot. Choose left or right before starting and keep that choice fixed. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Weaker Foot 30
challenges.objective: Complete 30 consecutive touches with only your weaker foot. Choose left or right before starting and keep that choice fixed. The other foot, another body part, a hand or the ground breaks the attempt.

challenges.title: Switch Six
challenges.objective: Complete 6 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: LR, repeated 3 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Switch Twelve
challenges.objective: Complete 12 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: LR, repeated 6 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Switch Thirty
challenges.objective: Complete 30 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: LR, repeated 15 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Double Step
challenges.objective: Complete 8 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: RRLL, repeated 2 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Double Step Twenty
challenges.objective: Complete 20 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: RRLL, repeated 5 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Triple Switch
challenges.objective: Complete 12 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: RRRLLL, repeated 2 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Right Lead
challenges.objective: Complete 16 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: RRRL, repeated 4 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Left Lead
challenges.objective: Complete 16 consecutive foot touches in this exact pattern: LLLR, repeated 4 times. L = left foot; R = right foot. Wrong foot, another body part or a drop breaks the pattern.

challenges.title: Best Streak 15
challenges.objective: Build your longest uninterrupted streak inside 15 seconds. After a drop you may start a new streak, but the clock keeps running. Only your longest streak is the score.

challenges.title: Best Streak 30
challenges.objective: Build your longest uninterrupted streak inside 30 seconds. After a drop you may start a new streak, but the clock keeps running. Only your longest streak is the score.

challenges.title: Best Streak 45
challenges.objective: Build your longest uninterrupted streak inside 45 seconds. After a drop you may start a new streak, but the clock keeps running. Only your longest streak is the score.

challenges.title: Best Streak 60
challenges.objective: Build your longest uninterrupted streak inside 60 seconds. After a drop you may start a new streak, but the clock keeps running. Only your longest streak is the score.

challenges.title: Touch Sprint 15
challenges.objective: Count as many valid touches as possible in 15 seconds. Drops are allowed; pickups and hand contacts do not count. The timer never resets.

challenges.title: Touch Sprint 30
challenges.objective: Count as many valid touches as possible in 30 seconds. Drops are allowed; pickups and hand contacts do not count. The timer never resets.

challenges.title: Touch Sprint 60
challenges.objective: Count as many valid touches as possible in 60 seconds. Drops are allowed; pickups and hand contacts do not count. The timer never resets.

challenges.title: Keep It Up 10
challenges.objective: Keep one uninterrupted streak alive for at least 10 seconds, measured from the first counted touch to a counted touch at or after 10 seconds. A drop or catch ends the attempt.

challenges.title: Keep It Up 20
challenges.objective: Keep one uninterrupted streak alive for at least 20 seconds, measured from the first counted touch to a counted touch at or after 20 seconds. A drop or catch ends the attempt.

challenges.title: Keep It Up 30
challenges.objective: Keep one uninterrupted streak alive for at least 30 seconds, measured from the first counted touch to a counted touch at or after 30 seconds. A drop or catch ends the attempt.

challenges.title: 3 in 3
challenges.objective: Reach 3 consecutive touches within 3 seconds after Go. A drop ends the attempt. Completion is the goal; saved elapsed time can be used for an identical-rule friend race.

challenges.title: 5 in 5
challenges.objective: Reach 5 consecutive touches within 5 seconds after Go. A drop ends the attempt. Completion is the goal; saved elapsed time can be used for an identical-rule friend race.

challenges.title: 10 in 10
challenges.objective: Reach 10 consecutive touches within 10 seconds after Go. A drop ends the attempt. Completion is the goal; saved elapsed time can be used for an identical-rule friend race.

challenges.title: 15 in 15
challenges.objective: Reach 15 consecutive touches within 15 seconds after Go. A drop ends the attempt. Completion is the goal; saved elapsed time can be used for an identical-rule friend race.

challenges.title: Race to 10
challenges.objective: Reach 10 consecutive touches as quickly as possible, within 30 seconds. Score is the time from Go to touch 10; lower is better. A drop or timeout is an unfinished attempt.

challenges.title: Race to 20
challenges.objective: Reach 20 consecutive touches as quickly as possible, within 45 seconds. Score is the time from Go to touch 20; lower is better. A drop or timeout is an unfinished attempt.

challenges.title: Race to 30
challenges.objective: Reach 30 consecutive touches as quickly as possible, within 60 seconds. Score is the time from Go to touch 30; lower is better. A drop or timeout is an unfinished attempt.

challenges.title: Race to 50
challenges.objective: Reach 50 consecutive touches as quickly as possible, within 90 seconds. Score is the time from Go to touch 50; lower is better. A drop or timeout is an unfinished attempt.

challenges.title: Three Fives
challenges.objective: Complete three separate streaks in order: 5, 5, 5 touches. Rest between rounds. Solo practice can retry a failed round; a scored series has one attempt per round.

challenges.title: Three Tens
challenges.objective: Complete three separate streaks in order: 10, 10, 10 touches. Rest between rounds. Solo practice can retry a failed round; a scored series has one attempt per round.

challenges.title: Three Twenties
challenges.objective: Complete three separate streaks in order: 20, 20, 20 touches. Rest between rounds. Solo practice can retry a failed round; a scored series has one attempt per round.

challenges.title: Rising Ladder
challenges.objective: Complete three separate streaks in order: 5, 10, 15 touches. Rest between rounds. Solo practice can retry a failed round; a scored series has one attempt per round.

challenges.title: Big Ladder
challenges.objective: Complete three separate streaks in order: 10, 20, 30 touches. Rest between rounds. Solo practice can retry a failed round; a scored series has one attempt per round.

challenges.title: Control Pyramid
challenges.objective: Complete three separate streaks in order: 5, 10, 5 touches. Rest between rounds. Solo practice can retry a failed round; a scored series has one attempt per round.

challenges.title: Steady Twenty
challenges.objective: Play three 20-second rounds. Achieve a best streak of at least 10 in every round. Your lowest round best is the series score.

challenges.title: Steady Thirty
challenges.objective: Play three 30-second rounds. Achieve a best streak of at least 20 in every round. Your lowest round best is the series score.

challenges.title: Streak Duel
challenges.objective: Both players get three separate 30-second attempts. Compare each player's highest valid uninterrupted streak; higher wins.

challenges.title: Sprint Duel
challenges.objective: Both players get three separate 30-second attempts. Compare their highest total of valid touches in one attempt; higher wins. Drops do not reset the clock.

challenges.title: First to Twenty
challenges.objective: Both players try Race to 20, with three attempts each. Compare the fastest finished attempt within 45 seconds; lower time wins.

challenges.title: Best of Three
challenges.objective: Play three paired 30-second best-streak rounds in order. Compare round 1 with round 1, and so on. Each round is recorded once; most round wins decides the match, with equal round scores drawn.

challenges.title: Mirror Me
challenges.objective: Pick an eight-touch left/right foot sequence and ask a friend to reproduce it. Both review the shared attempt video; matching the sequence completes the challenge.

challenges.title: Weak Foot Faceoff
challenges.objective: Each player locks their own weaker foot before starting and tries 10 uninterrupted touches. Completion is confirmed by shared-video review; both can complete. Treat this as a friendly skill challenge, not a verified ranking.

challenges.title: Team Hundred
challenges.objective: Work together: each player's best 30-second total contributes to a shared target of 100 touches. Three attempts per player; add the two best totals. The outcome is a team completion, not a winner.

challenges.title: Consistency Duel
challenges.objective: Each player records three 20-second best-streak rounds, once per round. Compare each player's lowest round score; the higher minimum wins. Equal minima draw.
